title: Method C Novel Complex Problem — Inclined Notch + Hole (Mixed-Mode Curved Crack, Damage-Following Adaptive Remeshing)
review_directive: Set up and run novel inclined notch + hole benchmark with Method C damage-following adaptive remeshing. Geometry: 1.0 x 1.0 mm plate, 0.5 mm notch from (0, 0.5) inclined +45 deg to tip (0.3536, 0.8536) mm, hole centre (0.65, 0.65) mm, radius 0.1 mm, EDGE_PULL vertical tension (top u2, bottom fixed), E = 210 GPa, nu = 0.3, l0 = 0.0075 mm, Gc = 0.0027 kN/mm. Damage-following corridor starting small around notch tip and growing ahead of curving tip (h_ref = 0.0035 mm <= l0/2). cKDTree nearest-neighbour state transfer. Single-increment Step 1 hold and RIKS Step 2. Stopping: tip reaches any plate edge (x >= 1.0 OR y >= 1.0 OR y <= 0) OR RF2 < 5% of peak. Local PC only, 0 PBS (cumulative 73), frozen UEL CE8D5EDC untouched, HPC job 1424916 untouched, periodic stall checks in force.
notes: Novel complex problem completed: 1.0 x 1.0 mm plate with 0.5 mm 45-deg inclined notch from (0, 0.5) to (0.3536, 0.8536) and circular hole at (0.65, 0.65) R=0.1 mm under vertical EDGE_PULL tension. Cycles 0 to 8 completed, verified, and pushed to origin/main. 100% transfer gate pass rate across all 8 adaptive cycles (max |Delta RF2| = 1.7857% <= 5.0%). Dynamic damage-following corridor mesh scaled from 8,387 to 27,608 elements (<35k limit, >97% quads, positive Jacobians). Peak reaction force F_peak = 0.8030 kN at Cycle 3; crack kinked down-right, deflected toward hole stress concentration, and entered hole boundary at [0.6224, 0.7461] mm (r = 0.1000 mm == R_hole) in Cycle 8 with chord s = 0.3196 mm and 59.70% post-peak load drop (RF2 = 0.3236 kN). Local PC only, 0 PBS, cumulative 73 preserved, frozen UEL CE8D5EDC untouched, MASTER_GOAL_STATUS strictly remains OPEN.
